cards.hook: Day 1: the order, and the old bifold still in the back pocket. Day 99: the last day to start a Ridge return.
cards.body: Switching from a bifold to a Ridge wallet, in order.
cards.offer_line: Start a return within 99 days of the order. Not for personalized, warranty-claim or certain limited-edition items. Ridge return terms as of 23 October 2026; they can change.

cards.hook: The order. The 99 days start here.
cards.body: Counted from the order, not from the day the box arrives.

cards.hook: Move the cards over to the Ridge wallet.
cards.body: Up to 12 cards and IDs go under the elastic.
It does not go in the bin. It waits until you decide.

cards.hook: Keep it, exchange it, or start a return.
cards.body: By day 99 from the order. Returns start in Ridge's returns portal; items should be in usable condition.

cards.hook: What the 99 days do not cover.
cards.body: Personalized items, warranty claim orders and certain limited editions. Original shipping fees are not refunded.
